name: Coda
one_liner: Superhuman Docs (formerly Coda), a document platform with a REST API for docs, tables, and rows.
auth_notes: Bearer API token sent in the Authorization header. Steps to create the token are not in the cached pages.
access_notes: Free of charge for all users in free and paid workspaces. Actions depend on the token owner's workspace role; createDoc requires a Doc Maker or Admin role.

buildability.rationale: Free, self-serve bearer token with a documented REST API and no approval gate. Per-endpoint role requirements and a 3-month deprecation policy apply. Endpoint count not stated.

identity.quote: The Superhuman Docs API is a RESTful API that lets you programmatically interact with data in Superhuman Docs (formerly Coda):

access.quote: We make the Superhuman Docs API available to all of our users free of charge, in both free and paid workspaces.

api_surface.quote: To fetch a subsequent page of results, pass the pageToken parameter.
Reading data (with the exceptions below): 100 requests per 6 seconds

mcp.quote: you may also want to consider using the Superhuman Docs MCP server.
